text:
Landed in 0b4eb7c. Template v12 is now the latest.
(1) Decisions: CLAUDE.md has a Decisions section. It says that a run-time decision is taken by a diagnostic library skill, on a tool's output and on a criterion a row of envelope/parameters.json hands it, and is undecided and the person's where the row is null. The build fills it from intake.decisions, each entry naming the skill, the tool and output field it judges, and the row behind each criterion. The build refuses, before anything is written, a skill the bundle does not carry or that is not a diagnostic, a field no tool returns, an input no row hands, and a row the parameters lack; the intake stage judges the same. The Procedure adds that a value a tool's output reports is read from it and not computed again. The schema does not admit intake.decisions yet: asked in 20261117-meta-macbook-20261116-1-9.
(2) Library: the next HOOMD-blue build can take series_settled@v1 and box_length_for_volume_fraction@v1, copied unchanged from contracts/examples. It can also take series_within_window@v1, a new diagnostic for acceptance in its band: a definition with hand-worked cases on an engine's acceptance, an instrument's temperature and a count, and undecided without an edge. The library index has 24 skills.
Not done: a diagnostic for the trend of a count. It needs a relation from a source read, which I have not read; the next build's meta session can build it under build-library-skill, or I will on a source you or the person name. The HOOMD-blue skills themselves are written by the next build, which is a run, and I start none.
Tests: test_template_v12, on an engine (acceptance band, settled energy) and a spectrometer (settled temperature), each decision's skill run through the bundle's own runner. With the mechanisms taken out, 5 of 7 fail; the two that pass test the library skills, which the stub leaves in place.
meta_agent/tests 285 OK, contracts/tests 114 OK.
